newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down, seen mixed.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down, seen mixed.

text.p: Pakistani stocks moved both ways before ending lower on Thursday amid squaring of positions before the Friday-Saturday weekend, dealers said.
They said political and economic uncertainty before general elections set for February 3 might keep the market mixed or range-bounded as major players would remain cautious.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 6.98 points, or 0.50 percent, to end at 1,378.57 after rising to 1,390.61 in early trade. Losers led gainers 141 to 90. Turnover fell to 24.19 million shares from 29.45 million on Wednesday.
Faysal Bank rose 0.40 to 21.85 rupees but Bank of Punjab fell 0.40 to 17. ICI Pakistan fell 0.40 to 17.75. Pakistan Suzuki Motors rose 0.75 to 43.25.
Hub Power Co rose 0.15 to 32.05, Pakistan State Oil fell 12 to 266. PTCL closed steady at 27.10.
